cards.ex: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe for the local marine life.
cards.exUz: Neft to'kilishi mahalliy dengiz hayoti uchun ekologik halokat bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatga katta zarar yetkazadigan, tuzatib bo'lmas falokat.

cards.ex: Environmental concerns are driving the shift towards electric vehicles.
cards.exUz: Ekologik tashvishlar elektromobillarga o'tishga sabab bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit bilan bog'liq xavotirlar va muammolar.

cards.ex: Factories are no longer allowed to discharge waste directly into the river.
cards.exUz: Fabrikalarga chiqindilarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri daryoga oqizishga ruxsat berilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Suyuqlik yoki chiqindini suvga yoki yerga to'kib yubormoq.

cards.ex: The drought had devastating effects on the local farms.
cards.exUz: Qurg'oqchilik mahalliy fermer xo'jaliklariga vayron qiluvchi ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy zarar yetkazadigan oqibatlar.

cards.ex: The pollution has caused irreversible damage to the coral reefs.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish marjon riflariga qaytarilmas zarar yetkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Tuzatib bo'lmaydigan zarar.

cards.ex: The government needs to implement stricter measures to reduce pollution.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ifloslanishni kamaytirish uchun qattiqroq choralar ko'rishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun qadamlar tashlamoq, harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Many smog-choked cities are starting to implement stricter emission controls.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab tutunli shaharlar qattiqroq chiqindi nazoratini joriy qila boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Havosi juda ifloslangan, tutun qoplagan shaharlar.

cards.ex: Don't flush medication down the toilet; it can contaminate the water supply.
cards.exUz: Dorilarni unitazga tashlamang; bu suv ta'minotini ifloslantirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Suv bilan biror narsani kanalizatsiyaga yuborish.

cards.ex: Strip mining has left scars on the landscape for decades.
cards.exUz: Ochiq kon qazish o'nlab yillar davomida landshaftda izlar qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yer ustidagi qazilma boyliklarni qazib olish usuli.

cards.ex: The river was heavily polluted by untreated sewage.
cards.exUz: Daryo tozalanmagan oqava suvlar bilan qattiq ifloslangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Tozalanmagan, ifloslangan oqava suvlar.

cards.ex: Water scarcity is becoming an increasingly pressing issue in many regions.
cards.exUz: Suv tanqisligi ko'plab hududlarda tobora dolzarb muammoga aylanib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tezda hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan muhim muammo.

cards.ex: We must avoid actions that despoil the earth for future generations.
cards.exUz: Kelajak avlodlar uchun yerni xarob qiladigan harakatlardan qochishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yerni buzish, vayron qilish, ifloslantirish.

cards.ex: The environmental lobby is pushing for stricter regulations on industrial waste.
cards.exUz: Ekologik lobbi sanoat chiqindilariga nisbatan qattiqroq qoidalarni talab qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ekologik masalalarni qo'llab-quvvatlovchi guruhlar.

cards.ex: Car exhaust fumes contribute significantly to urban air pollution.
cards.exUz: Avtomobil tutuni shahar havosining ifloslanishiga katta hissa qo'shadi.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobillardan chiqadigan zaharli gazlar.

cards.ex: Extreme weather events can wreak havoc on coastal communities.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda ob-havo hodisalari sohil bo'yidagi jamoalarga katta zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta zarar yetkazmoq, falokat keltirmoq.

cards.ex: We live in a throwaway society, consuming and discarding items at an alarming rate.
cards.exUz: Biz bir martalik jamiyatda yashaymiz, narsalarni xavotirli darajada iste'mol qilamiz va tashlab yuboramiz.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz narsalarni tashlab yuboradigan jamiyat.

cards.ex: Factories that pollute the environment should be held accountable.
cards.exUz: Atrofni ifloslantiradigan fabrikalar javobgar bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zararli moddalar chiqarib, ifloslantirish.

cards.ex: Water scarcity is a major challenge in arid regions.
cards.exUz: Suv tanqisligi qurg'oqchil hududlarda asosiy muammodir.
cards.uzDef: Suv resurslarining yetishmasligi, kamligi.

cards.ex: Check the air quality index before exercising outdoors.
cards.exUz: Ochiq havoda mashq qilishdan oldin havo sifati indeksini tekshiring.
cards.uzDef: Havoning ifloslik darajasini ko'rsatuvchi ko'rsatkich.

cards.ex: The improper disposal of hazardous waste can have severe consequences.
cards.exUz: Xavfli chiqindilarni noto'g'ri utilizatsiya qilish og'ir oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va atrof-muhit uchun xavfli bo'lgan chiqindilar.

cards.ex: The spill released toxic chemicals into the river.
cards.exUz: To'kilgan narsa daryoga zaharli kimyoviy moddalarni chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va atrof-muhit uchun zaharli bo'lgan kimyoviy moddalar.

cards.ex: Pollution can significantly degrade the environment.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish atrof-muhitni sezilarli darajada buzishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitning sifatini pasaytirish, yomonlashtirish.

cards.ex: We must respect and protect the natural world.
cards.exUz: Biz tabiiy dunyoni hurmat qilishimiz va himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiat, odamlar aralashuvisiz mavjud bo'lgan olam.

cards.ex: A lot of plastic waste ends up in the ocean.
cards.exUz: Ko'p plastik chiqindilar oxir-oqibat okeanga tushib qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Oxir-oqibat bir joyga yetib bormoq.

cards.ex: She is a dedicated environmental activist.
cards.exUz: U fidoyi ekologik faol.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish uchun faol harakat qiluvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: Residents voiced concerns about the new factory's potential pollution.
cards.exUz: Aholi yangi zavodning potentsial ifloslanishi haqida xavotir bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xavotirlarni og'zaki yoki yozma ravishda ifodalash.

cards.ex: Planting trees can help offset the damage caused by deforestation.
cards.exUz: Daraxt ekish o'rmonlarning kesilishi oqibatida kelib chiqqan zararni qoplashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Zarar oqibatlarini kamaytirish, muvozanatga keltirish.

cards.ex: The company is responsible for cleaning up the contaminated land.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ifloslangan yerni tozalash uchun javobgardir.
cards.uzDef: Zaharli moddalar bilan ifloslangan yer maydoni.

cards.ex: Water contamination poses a serious threat to public health.
cards.exUz: Suvning ifloslanishi aholi salomatligi uchun jiddiy tahdid soladi.
cards.uzDef: Suvning zaharli moddalar bilan ifloslanishi.

cards.ex: Industrial emissions continue to foul the air in many cities.
cards.exUz: Sanoat chiqindilari ko'plab shaharlarda havoni ifloslantirishda davom etmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Havoni zaharli moddalar bilan ifloslash.
